items.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know Eiji Kitamura? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, so there is an English jazz band.
That’s right, in fact a fellow named Buck Clayton played in Shanghai like in the 30’s. Do you know Eiji Kitamura?
